$comment: Written by opencastle sync — do not edit. Change .opencastle/ (or a baseline) and run sync; opencastle review explains a change.

agents/architect.description: Software architect: strategic decisions, roadmap planning, ADRs, system design, technology evaluation.

agents/developer.description: Full-stack developer: pages, components, routing, layouts, API routes and their contracts, server-side logic, feature implementation.

agents/devops-expert.description: DevOps and release: deployments, CI/CD, cron jobs, security headers, caching, environment variables, plus pre-release verification and changelogs.

agents/performance-expert.description: Performance optimization expert: frontend, backend, build performance.

agents/researcher.description: Codebase exploration specialist: deep research, pattern discovery, git archaeology, context gathering before implementation. Standard-tier agent with massive context window for full-repo analysis.

agents/reviewer.description: Mandatory fast reviewer: validates every agent delegation output before acceptance. Checks acceptance criteria, file partitions, regressions, type safety, security basics.

agents/security-expert.description: Security expert: authentication, authorization, data access policies, security headers, input validation, API security, vulnerability management.

agents/team-lead.description: Coordinates work that spans several areas: plans it, hands each part to the specialist agent that fits, checks every result, and delivers one reviewed pull request.

agents/testing-expert.description: Testing expert: E2E tests, integration tests, browser validation, test suites via browser automation, test file authoring.

agents/ui-ux-expert.description: UI/UX expert: designs, builds accessible, consistent UI components with deep design system knowledge.

agents/writer.description: Writer: user-facing copy, project documentation, and search metadata — UI microcopy, error messages, docs, roadmaps, meta tags, structured data.

prompts/bootstrap-customizations.description: Completes the .opencastle/ project files on an existing codebase: checks what opencastle init read from the code, and fills in the "Still to describe" list at the end of each file by reading the code.

prompts/brainstorm.description: Collaborative brainstorm to explore requirements, approaches, trade-offs BEFORE committing to a plan. Use when task has ambiguity, multiple valid approaches, or significant design decisions.

prompts/bug-fix.description: Fix a bug in this session: reproduce it, find the root cause, fix it with a regression test, verify it, and open a pull request.

prompts/convoy.description: Plan work as a convoy — tasks that agents run in parallel, each in its own git worktree, merged onto one branch — with the experimental convoy engine, and hand the plan over to run.

prompts/create-skill.description: Scaffold new skill file with proper frontmatter, structure, registration. Use when adding new domain skill to AI configuration.

prompts/implement-feature.description: Implement a feature or change in this session — a roadmap item or a small follow-up: understand it, plan it to its size, build it with tests, verify it, have it reviewed, and open a pull request.

prompts/resolve-pr-comments.description: Resolve GitHub PR review comments by reading them, grouping by file, applying fixes systematically.
